title: Scale probe: parallel sandbox executions - scale probe snapshot
driver: multiprocessing spawn harness, 1 sandbox call per task (driver script of this snapshot not retained; raw per-N files: scale_dgx_100/500/1000.json)
observations: Error rate 0% across all runs (0/1700 sandbox calls).
Throughput scales with N: 101.8 -> 503.1 -> 845.0 exec/s (amortizing engine pool + per-worker module compilation).
fuel deterministic per platform (DGX spread caused only by variable input length 'scale-N': 2401-2560).
P99 242-335ms = per-task multiprocessing spawn overhead (isolated mode); the persistent MCP channel reaches 0.89 ms/call (see docs/comparison-mcp-servers.md section 2).
Single-run P50 on DGX 7.4 ms vs. macOS 1.4 ms - same wasmtime, same architecture, different platform engines (consistent with the cross-platform determinism finding: fuel/elapsed are platform-bound).
conclusion: 1000 parallel sandbox executions on the DGX Spark in 1.18 s wall time, 0 errors, deterministic fuel values. 'Verified. Not claimed.'
